build_RowSelfAttention: build a RowSelfAttention module to compute self-attention over rows of a 2D MSA input tensor
build_ColumnSelfAttention: build a ColumnSelfAttention module to compute self-attention over columns of a 2D MSA input tensor
run_RowSelfAttention_forward: run the RowSelfAttention forward pass on a 4D tensor with shape rows, cols, batch, embed_dim
run_ColumnSelfAttention_forward: run the ColumnSelfAttention forward pass on a 4D tensor with optional padding mask support
review_RowSelfAttention_batched_forward: review the RowSelfAttention batched forward method that chunks rows to limit memory usage during inference
